d: Anthropic's Nov. 6 post on agent memory names four parts, transcripts, notes, wikis and injected context, and calls the offline pass that reorganizes them a ___; one model that kept nine memory files earned four Pokemon badges where another with 413 files earned one
Ai2's ToyBlocks, posted Nov. 6, opens a robot-arm simulation with 85,336 demonstrations and 144 million frames of ___ for learning to stack blocks
n: Six documents from the weekend. Anthropic's engineering post on agent memory names four parts, a searchable transcript, memory notes, a memory representation such as a wiki, and the context injected at the start, and calls the offline pass that reorganizes them dreaming. Its numbers argue for fewer, better notes: one model wrote 413 memory files across 225 folders and earned one badge in a Pokemon game, while a newer model wrote nine files in two folders and earned four; a wiki built over 350,000 files answered 48 percent of questions after 128 sessions, up from 13. Ai2 opened ToyBlocks, a tabletop robot world with 85,336 demonstrations and 144 million frames, where the agent solved 30 of 30 stacking tasks and a skill learned in simulation scored 80 percent there and 81.1 on the real arm. Nvidia published two pieces from Korea: a chip startup will link its decode processors to Nvidia racks for sovereign AI systems due in 2028, and a two-day Seoul event released deployment recipes for four Korean open models. Nvidia's 6G roundup reports a university model that forecasts network demand ten minutes ahead so base stations can sleep, cutting radio power 45.6 percent. The European Commission preliminarily found a short-video recommender in breach of the Digital Services Act for its rabbit-hole effect. For your work: the memory post is the one to read. Give your AI one place for notes, keep the notes few and plain, and let it reorganize them on a schedule instead of piling up files. The Well is cooked on Anthropic's models, for the record.

sources.title: The components of agent memory: transcripts, notes, wikis, injected context, and dreaming as the offline reorganizing pass; nine files and four badges against 413 files and one; wiki over 350,000 files from 13 to 48 percent across 128 sessions (Anthropic)

ToyBlocks: a controlled tabletop world for robot learning, 85,336 demonstrations, about 1,600 hours, 144 million frames; 30 of 30 stacking tasks; 80.0 percent in simulation and 81.1 on the real arm (Ai2 on Hugging Face)

Open source 6G research roundup: developer adoption up 10x in a year, over a million downloads; base-station sleep forecasting cuts radio power 45.6 percent; neural receiver gains up to about 60 percent (NVIDIA)
Preliminary finding that a short-video recommender breaches the Digital Services Act for its rabbit-hole effect; the findings cover risk assessment and mitigation (European Commission)
NVLink Fusion collaboration for sovereign AI in Korea: GPUs handle prefill, a startup's R200 processors handle decode, on the MGX rack design, systems expected ready in 2028 (NVIDIA newsroom)
AI Day Seoul, Nov. 8 to 9: more than 2,000 attendees; deployment recipes for four Korean open models; over 20 startups at the partnership forum (NVIDIA)
